PRODUCTION DESIGN SPEC:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: one final independent square flat opaque poster, no mockup, no panels.
Only create the assigned R7-B04-M5 poster; the full request for five is handled outside this single call. Do not print internal role names or instructions.
요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력
Assigned width:height ratio 1:1. Single full-bleed opaque yellow square artwork.

DESIGN: The subject is the physically connected pressure-release and shape recovery of ONE large purple clay mass between TWO opening clay hands. Near-frontal camera, gentle depth with all text fronts square to viewer. The central mass dominates the non-text scene, approximately x27–73%, y27–61%. Its top center has risen into a rounded substantial dome, while its lower body is still squashed into a wide flattened base. This must visibly be the same continuous body: broad shallow finger compression hollows on both left and right sides, locally dense folded clay at those hollows and the widened lower base, transitioning smoothly into the recovering dome with sparse soft handworked traces. No second blob, no before/after sequence, no lettering formed into the blob. Give the purple mass enough real volume, silhouette change and compressed lateral surfaces to communicate the event even if all text is hidden.

Two low-saturation warm pale peach CLAY hands enter from the lower left and lower right edges, their wrists and forearms angle outward and create a large central opening for information. Hands have coherent five-finger anatomy and are opening outward after squeezing. Palms face toward the central clay. Fingertips and thumbs have just withdrawn from the corresponding broad impressions, with distinct thin yellow air gaps between finger pads and compressed clay surfaces. Match the groove placement to the nearby fingers so the pressure history is visible. Keep the hands beside the object, not in front of its dome or its deformation; no touching support/cradling pose. The release gesture and the rebounding dome form the first glance. No arrows, motion lines, tiny symbols or confetti are needed.

COLOR/MATERIAL: strong complementary saturated bright purple clay against a vivid warm yellow background. Purple has matte opaque modeling-clay body, broad soft light from upper left, controlled soft contact shadows and rounded handworked edges, no plastic gloss, balloon sheen, liquid drips, or uniform noise texture. Hands are pale muted peach and remain secondary. Clay typography shares consistent light and surface logic. Background is clean yellow, with no fake print grain or extra shapes.

TYPE/SPATIAL RELATION: Title is one wide legible centered line directly above the mass, around x10–90%, y8–21%, aligned with the opening width of the hands, not pasted onto the clay. Use visibly thick, raised PURPLE Korean clay characters with flat front faces, clear syllable counters and normal Hangul proportions. Preserve the three word groups and ordinary word spacing; don't stretch glyphs or exaggerate gaps. Title wording is the supplied title copy.
Below the body's base, between the opening wrists, reserve about x17–83%, y65–94% for the five other supplied entries, centered and clearly grouped with generous line spacing. Place the supplied event-name line first, then the supplied action-description line; below them date/time, venue, and application URL. All six entries appear exactly ONCE. Event line slightly larger than the following information, but all Korean lettering remains clearly raised clay; information has shallower extrusion and a darker purple front for high contrast on yellow. Let the info opening govern arm placement. No lower banner, no added card, no decorative label. Long description, date/time and URL get sufficient real width and normal letter proportions rather than horizontal compression. Date/time and URL remain single lines. Copy never overlaps hands or deformation. Leave a safe bottom margin. Only the six exact supplied strings may appear, without added punctuation, logos, labels, sponsors, watermarks or invented copy. Render 13:00–18:00 with the supplied en dash, not a hyphen. Render URL with lowercase letters, exact dot/slash/hyphen, and normal word space after 신청.
